notes: Measured on 1920x1080 frames at 0/30/90/180/300/420/700 s of the pilot source (see HANDOFF.md).
Caption and speaker-label rects sit strictly inside their opaque overlays; when an overlay is absent the rect shows camera pixels, so presence gates block OCR.
The roster lists nickname + role for every seat: answer-bearing, private only.
The camera area contains seat paddles and editorial overlays (花字, crowns, transition cards): excluded from everything.
Label rect starts at x=156: the white box's left edge sits at x~146-150 and camera pixels bleed in left of it; label ink starts at x>=167.
Board diff runs at full resolution with a 0.2% pixel threshold: at 1/4 scale a new 12 px text row (e.g. '投票中' at ~231-237 s) stayed under the default 2% threshold and was only caught by a guard OCR.

v2 adds 'subtitle_plain': the edit sometimes shows subtitles as white outlined text with no yellow bar and no speaker label (e.g. 315.9 s, 2020.8 s). v1 missed them; in the pilot they surfaced only as short 'ASR-only' fragments.
v2 label gate accepts either subtitle style (requires_any): the white label box stays on screen for bar-less subtitles, so those captions can be attributed too.
